## Core Technical Competencies & Specializations

   - Algorithms: Big-O Time & Space Complexity Analysis, Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Binary Search, Fast & Slow Pointers, Recursion, Backtracking, Divide and Conquer.
   - Data Structures: Dynamic Arrays, Strings, Singly/Doubly Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Binary Trees, Binary Search Trees (BST), Heaps, Hash Maps, Hash Sets.

2. **Frontend Engineering**:
   - Frameworks: React.js (v18 & v19), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+).
   - Styling: Tailwind CSS (v4), Vanilla CSS3, Responsive Web Design, Flexbox, CSS Grid.
   - Animations & Interactions: GSAP (GreenSock), ScrollTrigger, Lenis Smooth Scroll, micro-interactions.
   - State & Data Fetching: TanStack React Query, TanStack Router, TanStack Start.

3. **Backend & Cloud Architecture**:
   - Runtime & Framework: Node.js, Express.js.
   - API Design: RESTful API standards, JSON response patterns, HTTP status codes, middleware design, JWT authentication, cookie/session management.
   - Databases: MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose ODM, Supabase, PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS), MySQL.
   - Deployment: Vercel, Render, GitHub Pages, Netlify.

## Verified Portfolio Projects
1. **KisanSarthi AI — Krishi Suraksha Platform**
   - Context: Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2026) Initiative.
   - Architecture: Multimodal Google Gemini Vision AI integrated with React 18, Leaflet geo-mapping, Open-Meteo telemetry, and Supabase PostgreSQL.
   - Features: Image-based crop disease diagnosis, disease progression heatmaps, microclimate pest hazard forecasts, ICAR compliance farmer advisories.
   - Live URL: https://krishi-suraksha-sih2026.vercel.app
   - Repository: https://github.com/gopal-maddheshiya/krishi-suraksha-sih2026

2. **Arun Gopal Traders — Bilingual Grocery & Retail Platform**
   - Architecture: React 19 with TanStack Start, Supabase PostgreSQL, Realtime Pub/Sub sync, and Gemini AI.
   - Features: Real-time stock status, Row Level Security, bilingual Hindi and English localization, dynamic PDF invoice generation, admin dashboard.
   - Live URL: https://arun-gopal-traders.vercel.app/
   - Repository: https://github.com/gopal-maddheshiya/trading-company

3. **DSA & Interview Prep Tracker**
   - Architecture: Full-stack MERN (MongoDB Atlas, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, Recharts).
   - Features: Spaced repetition interval revision queues, native MongoDB aggregation pipelines, 20-week practice heatmap, multi-attempt solution timeline logs.
   - Live URL: https://dsa-tracker-gopal.vercel.app
   - Repository: https://github.com/gopal-maddheshiya/dsa-tracker

4. **Node.js & MongoDB Message REST API**
   - Architecture: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose.
